description: policy() golden pairs: every platform's install capability, plus what the automatic-updates preference does to each. Output is the full {action, check, autoDownload, canInstall} tuple. Regenerate is manual; these pin the policy for the Swift port the same way fixtures/progress.json pins the progress curve.

cases.name: darwin signed with a Developer ID
darwin unsigned: notifies, does not download what it cannot install
linux not running as an AppImage: does not even check
an unknown platform falls through to notify
ios cannot install its own update, so it announces and hands off
ios from source does not check at all
win32 with automatic updates turned off narrows install to manual
darwin signed with automatic updates turned off narrows install to manual
an AppImage with automatic updates turned off narrows install to manual
darwin unsigned with automatic updates turned off is unchanged: it could never install
linux outside an AppImage with automatic updates turned off is unchanged
ios with automatic updates turned off is unchanged, and never becomes manual
a source run stays none even with automatic updates turned off
